items.t: Simon® Breaks Ground on Sagefield™, Bringing Curated Retail, Distinctive Dining, and Design Excellence to South Nashville
items.sum: Today, Simon®, a real estate investment trust engaged in the ownership of premier shopping, dining, entertainment, and mixed-use destinations officially broke ground on SagefieldTM, a 100-acre, open-air destination situated at the crossroads of Interstate 65 and Interstate 840 in Thompson's Station opening in late 2028.

items.t: Evercore ISI Group Maintains In-Line on Simon Property Group, Raises Price Target to $227
items.sum: Evercore ISI Group analyst Steve Sakwa maintains Simon Property Group (NYSE:SPG) with a In-Line and raises the price target from $225 to $227.

items.t: UBS Maintains Neutral on Simon Property Group, Raises Price Target to $235
items.sum: UBS analyst Michael Goldsmith maintains Simon Property Group (NYSE:SPG) with a Neutral and raises the price target from $205 to $235.

items.t: ETFs Are Net Sellers of Simon Property Group (SPG) on Nov. 9
items.sum: ETFs sold $12.3 million of Simon Property Group stock on Nov. 9.

items.t: Simon Property Group: A Great REIT, But No Longer A Great Deal
items.sum: Simon Property Group is rated Hold, as the current valuation reflects fair value with limited margin of safety amid industry headwinds. Learn more about SPG stock here.

items.t: Simon Property Group (SPG) Looks Fully Valued As It Raises 2026 FFO Outlook And Dividend
items.sum: Simon Property Group (SPG) has narrowed its focus on shareholder returns, pairing a higher 2026 real estate FFO outlook with a dividend increase and ongoing buybacks after reporting solid third quarter operating metrics.
